thread:
emma (AE): FYI — OrionCorp wants a 10-business-day POC: invoice extraction -> structured JSON + short policy answers for support agents. They need starter prompts, acceptance criteria, a minimal security posture for uploads, and a POC pricing note. Can we align owners and a fast timeline?

diego (SE): I'll produce a 30-row prompt inventory (edge cases: rotated text, torn receipts, multi-currency, negative line items). Need sample OCR->text snippets; will assume plain text with inplace line breaks. Quick Q: acceptable p50 latency?

emma (AE): they want interactive UI feel; p50 ~ 450ms is acceptable if we document it. sending 8 anonymized OCR examples to the shared drive now.

ravi (ML Eng): Baseline recommendations: hosted redwood/opt-xxl-quant for dev, quantized small model as cost fallback. Baseline extractor prompt (strict JSON):
```
System: Extract only JSON with keys: vendor, invoice_date(YYYY-MM-DD), currency, total, tax, items[]. For each field include confidence 0-1 and original text span.
User: <OCR_TEXT>
```
Variants: strict-json, allow-fallback, include-spans-only. For policy QA (agent-facing):
```
System: Answer only using supplied policy snippets. If unknown respond: "No relevant info found." Limit to 140 chars.
User: <policy_question>
```
These are eval-friendly and reduce hallucination.

julia (CSM): Deliverables & owners idea: 1) prompt CSV + exemplar outputs (diego, 48h), 2) eval harness + pass/fail thresholds (ravi, 72h), 3) security one-pager + questionnaire answers (sophia, EOD), 4) POC credits + billing note (mark, 24h), 5) kickoff + demo plan (emma+julia, schedule this week).

mark (Pricing): We can offer 70k tokens/day credits for the 10-day POC. If they request reserved capacity we should time-box a short quote; need concurrency estimate.

diego (SE): Token estimate: avg extraction request ~420 tokens (input+output), policy QA ~120 tokens. Peak concurrency ~8-12 during demos. Batching for background jobs likely to reduce per-request cost.

sophia (Security): OrionCorp's checklist asks for CMK, VPC peering, audit logs (90d), and data deletion controls. For POC minimal posture: TLS in transit, redact PII in logs, role-based access, and temporary managed keys with option to move to CMK if they sign DPA. Recommend synthetic dataset week1, gated real uploads week2 after DPA. I can prepare language for the questionnaire.

ravi (ML Eng): Suggested acceptance thresholds: vendor & total exact_match >= 92%, hallucination_rate < 3% on policy QA, p50 latency < 500ms for extraction, median inference cost per request <= $0.025 (hosted estimate). We'll expose a used_fallback boolean if regex heuristics are used.

emma (AE): Customer asked about fallback plan if model degrades mid-demo. Can we provide a deterministic extractor fallback for critical fields?

diego (SE): Yes — implement regex+heuristics fallback for total, currency, invoice_date. Response includes metadata: {used_fallback: true, fallback_reason: "low_confidence"}. We'll document expected accuracy delta.

mark (Pricing): Confirmed credits. I'll send a one-page note showing covered tokens, expected overage rates, and optional reserved pricing for a short term.

sophia (Security): Quick clarification: will we store uploaded invoices during the POC? If yes, need DPA addendum and storage scoping. Recommend ephemeral storage by default.

emma (AE): Proposal to customer: synthetic uploads week1, gated real uploads week2 pending DPA signature and storage scoping.

julia (CSM): Action item recap: diego -> prompt CSV + sample outputs (48h), ravi -> eval harness + threshold config (72h), sophia -> security one-pager + questionnaire answers (EOD), mark -> credits + billing note (24h), emma/julia -> schedule kickoff and confirm demo plan (this week). Please update thread when artifacts are uploaded.

diego (SE): Ack — uploading prompt CSV and a tiny demo notebook to the shared drive. Will include expected JSON outputs and a short eval command:
```
python run_eval.py --prompts prompts.csv --model redwood/opt-xxl-quant --metrics exact_match,field_confidence,hallucination_rate
```

ravi (ML Eng): Ack — I'll wire CI to run the eval and post dashboards for latency/cost/quality.

sophia (Security): Ack — drafting the one-pager now with CMK options and DPA language.

emma (AE): Thanks team. Tentative kickoff Thursday 11am PT. Closing thread after deliverables posted. :rocket:
